title: देउवालाई सचिनको जवाफ- तपाईँलाई खबरिलालले ढाँटे दाइ, म हिंसामा विश्वास राख्दिनँ
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाली कांग्रेसका युवा नेता सचिन तिमल्सिनाले पार्टीका पूर्वसभापति तथा पूर्वप्रधानमन्त्री शेरबहादुर देउवाले आफूमाथि लक्षित गर्दै लगाएको आरोपको कडा प्रतिवाद गरेका छन् । उनले देउवाको अभिव्यक्तिलाई ‘वाहियात’ र ‘गलत सूचनामा आधारित’ भएको टिप्पणी गरेका हुन् । देउवाले हालै पोखरामा ‘समानान्तर कांग्रेस’को गण्डकी प्रदेशस्तरीय दोस्रो अधिवेशनलाई सम्बोधन आफूलाई मार्नुपर्छ भन्नेलाई गगन थापाले टिकट दिएको आरोप लगाएका थिए । गगनको नाम नलिईकन उनले भनेका थिए, ‘शेरबहादुर देउवाको घरमा आक्रमण गर्नुपर्छ भन्नेलाई टिकट दियो । मलाई मार्नुपर्छ भन्नेलाई पनि टिकट दियो ४ नम्बरमा । देशभर हाम्रो नेताजीहरूको घरमा आगो लगाउने र हामीलाई मार्न खोज्ने को को छ स्पष्ट भैसकेको छ ।’ देउवाको यो आरोपलाई आफूप्रति लक्षित मान्दै तिमल्सिनाले सामाजिक सञ्जालबाट जवाफ दिएका हुन् । उनी गत फागुन २१ मा सम्पन्न प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनमा काठमाडौं क्षेत्र नम्बर ४ बाट कांग्रेसको उम्मेदवार बनेर पराजित भएका थिए । देउवाको उक्त अभिव्यक्तिको जवाफ दिँदै तिमल्सिनाले आफू कुनै पनि किसिमको हिंसामा विश्वास राख्ने व्यक्ति नभएको स्पष्ट पारेका छन् । ‘बरु हिंसाको सिकार हुँदा पनि देशमा शान्ति छाउनुपर्छ भन्नेमा दृढ छु,’ उनले लेखेका छन् । तिमल्सिनाले देउवा वरपरका व्यक्तिहरूले उनलाई गलत सूचना दिएर भ्रममा पारिरहेको आरोप लगाएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरैले ढाँटे दाइ, अझै ढाँट्दैछन् । जबसम्म शेरबहादुर आफैँ सूचना जम्मा गर्थे, गजब थिए । जबदेखि अरूको सूचनामा भर पर्न थाले, बिजोग भयो दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘समस्या जति तपाईँमा हो, त्योभन्दा धेरै तपाईँका खबरिलालमा हो दाइ ।’ पार्टी सभापति गगन थापामाथि पनि तिनै ‘ढटुवाहरू’को सूचनाका आधारमा देउवाले आरोप लगाएको तिमल्सिनाको दाबी छ । देउवाले आफूलाई नचिनेको बताउँदै उनले आफ्नो र परिवारको कांग्रेसमा रहेको योगदानबारे पाँचथर कांग्रेसलाई सोध्न वा केन्द्रीय कार्यालयमा आफूले नेतृत्व गरेको ‘पोलिसी ह्याकाथन’ कार्यक्रममा देउवा स्वयं सहभागी भएको घटना स्मरण गर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । पार्टी कार्यालय जल्दा झन्डा ओढाउन जाने पहिलो व्यक्ति आफू नै रहेको र त्यसमा आजीवन गर्व रहनेसमेत उनले उल्लेख गरेका छन् । तिमल्सिनाले देउवाको सभापतित्व कार्यकालमाथि गम्भीर राजनीतिक तथा नैतिक प्रश्नसमेत उठाएका छन् । देउवाको कार्यकालमा मनपरी गठबन्धन भएको, जनतालाई प्रतिपक्षविहीन हालतमा छोडिएको, राजनीतिमा सिद्धान्त हुँदैन भन्ने भाष्य स्थापित गर्न खोजिएको र सत्ताका लागि जोसँग पनि गठबन्धन गर्न सक्ने प्रवृत्ति हाबी भएको उनको आरोप छ । ‘हरेक महिना आउने आर्थिक अपचलनका आरोपले पार्टी झनै कमजोर बन्यो । यो सबै तपाईँको कार्यकालमा भएको हो,’ तिमल्सिनाले लेखेका छन्, ‘कांग्रेस सत्तामा बलियो–कमजोर भइरह्यो तर नैतिक हिसाबले कमजोर तपाईँको सभापतित्वमा मात्रै भएको हो ।’ उनले देउवाप्रति सम्मान रहेको उल्लेख गर्दै बीपी कोइरालाको राजनीतिक संस्कार स्मरण गराएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरै कुराको लागि इज्जत गर्छु तर आलोचना गर्दा घटिया आरोप लगाउनु हुन्न भन्ने स्वयं तपाईँको र मेरो आदर्श नेता बीपी कोइरालाले सिकाउनु भएको छ दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन् । Kathmandu. Nepali Congress youth leader Sachin Timalsina has strongly refuted the allegations leveled against him by former party president and former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba. He has termed Deuba's statement as 'nonsense' and 'based on false information'. Deuba, while addressing the second Gandaki Province-level convention of the 'Parallel Congress' in Pokhara recently, had accused Gagan Thapa of giving tickets to those who said he should be killed. Without naming Gagan, he had said, 'He gave tickets to those who said Sher Bahadur Deuba's house should be attacked. He also gave tickets to those who said I should be killed at number 4. It has become clear who is trying to set fire to the houses of our Netaji's across the country and kill us.' Timalsina responded on social media, considering Deuba's accusations as targeted at him. He was defeated as the Congress candidate from Kathmandu Constituency No. 4 in the House of Representatives elections held on March 21. Responding to Deuba's statement, Timalsina clarified that he is not a person who believes in any kind of violence. "Instead, I am determined that peace should prevail in the country even when it is a victim of violence," he wrote. Timalsina has accused people around Deuba of misleading him by giving him false information. "Many have lied to you, brother, and they are still lying to you. As long as Sher Bahadur gathered information himself, he was wonderful. Ever since he started relying on information from others, things have gone wrong, brother," he wrote. "The problem is more with your informants than with you, brother." Timalsina claims that Deuba has also accused party president Gagan Thapa based on information from the same 'liars'. Stating that Deuba does not know him, he has urged him to ask the Panchthar Congress about his and his family's contribution to the Congress or to recall the incident in which Deuba himself participated in the 'Policy Hackathon' program that he led at the central office. He has also mentioned that he was the first person to hoist the flag when the party office was set on fire and that he will be proud of it for the rest of his life. Timalsina has also raised serious political and moral questions about Deuba's presidency. He alleges that arbitrary alliances were formed during Deuba's tenure, that the people were left without an opposition, that there was an attempt to establish a narrative that there is no principle in politics, and that there was a tendency to form alliances with anyone for power. "The party has become even weaker with the allegations of financial mismanagement coming every month. All this happened during your tenure," Timalsina wrote. "The Congress has been growing stronger and weaker in power, but it has only become morally weak under your presidency." He mentioned his respect for Deuba and reminded him of BP Koirala's political culture. 'I respect you for many things, but your and my ideal leader BP Koirala himself has taught me not to make baseless accusations when criticizing,' he wrote.

फागुन २१ मा सम्पन्न प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनमा काठमाडौं क्षेत्र नम्बर ४ बाट कांग्रेसको उम्मेदवार बनेर पराजित भएका थिए । देउवाको उक्त अभिव्यक्तिको जवाफ दिँदै तिमल्सिनाले आफू कुनै पनि किसिमको हिंसामा विश्वास राख्ने व्यक्ति नभएको स्पष्ट पारेका छन् । ‘बरु हिंसाको सिकार हुँदा पनि देशमा शान्ति छाउनुपर्छ भन्नेमा दृढ छु,’ उनले लेखेका छन् । तिमल्सिनाले देउवा वरपरका व्यक्तिहरूले उनलाई गलत सूचना दिएर भ्रममा पारिरहेको आरोप लगाएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरैले ढाँटे दाइ, अझै ढाँट्दैछन् । जबसम्म शेरबहादुर आफैँ सूचना जम्मा गर्थे, गजब थिए । जबदेखि अरूको सूचनामा भर पर्न थाले, बिजोग भयो दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘समस्या जति तपाईँमा हो, त्योभन्दा धेरै तपाईँका खबरिलालमा हो दाइ ।’ पार्टी सभापति गगन थापामाथि पनि तिनै ‘ढटुवाहरू’को सूचनाका आधारमा देउवाले आरोप लगाएको तिमल्सिनाको दाबी छ । देउवाले आफूलाई नचिनेको बताउँदै उनले आफ्नो र परिवारको कांग्रेसमा रहेको योगदानबारे पाँचथर कांग्रेसलाई सोध्न वा केन्द्रीय कार्यालयमा आफूले नेतृत्व गरेको ‘पोलिसी ह्याकाथन’ कार्यक्रममा देउवा स्वयं सहभागी भएको घटना स्मरण गर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । पार्टी कार्यालय जल्दा झन्डा ओढाउन जाने पहिलो व्यक्ति आफू नै रहेको र त्यसमा आजीवन गर्व रहनेसमेत उनले उल्लेख गरेका छन् । तिमल्सिनाले देउवाको सभापतित्व कार्यकालमाथि गम्भीर राजनीतिक तथा नैतिक प्रश्नसमेत उठाएका छन् । देउवाको कार्यकालमा मनपरी गठबन्धन भएको, जनतालाई प्रतिपक्षविहीन हालतमा छोडिएको, राजनीतिमा सिद्धान्त हुँदैन भन्ने भाष्य स्थापित गर्न खोजिएको र सत्ताका लागि जोसँग पनि गठबन्धन गर्न सक्ने प्रवृत्ति हाबी भएको उनको आरोप छ । ‘हरेक महिना आउने आर्थिक अपचलनका आरोपले पार्टी झनै कमजोर बन्यो । यो सबै तपाईँको कार्यकालमा भएको हो,’ तिमल्सिनाले लेखेका छन्, ‘कांग्रेस सत्तामा बलियो–कमजोर भइरह्यो तर नैतिक हिसाबले कमजोर तपाईँको सभापतित्वमा मात्रै भएको हो ।’ उनले देउवाप्रति सम्मान रहेको उल्लेख गर्दै बीपी कोइरालाको राजनीतिक संस्कार स्मरण गराएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरै कुराको लागि इज्जत गर्छु तर आलोचना गर्दा घटिया आरोप लगाउनु हुन्न भन्ने स्वयं तपाईँको र मेरो आदर्श नेता बीपी कोइरालाले सिकाउनु भएको छ दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन् । Kathmandu. Nepali Congress youth leader Sachin Timalsina has strongly refuted the allegations leveled against him by former party president and former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba. He has termed Deuba's statement as 'nonsense' and 'based on false information'. Deuba, while addressing the second Gandaki Province-level convention of the 'Parallel Congress' in Pokhara recently, had accused Gagan Thapa of giving tickets to those who said he should be killed. Without naming Gagan, he had said, 'He gave tickets to those who said Sher Bahadur Deuba's house should be attacked. He also gave tickets to those who said I should be killed at number 4. It has become clear who is trying to set fire to the houses of our Netaji's across the country and kill us.' Timalsina responded on social media, considering Deuba's accusations as targeted at him. He was defeated as the Congress candidate from Kathmandu Constituency No. 4 in the House of Representatives elections held on March 21. Responding to Deuba's statement, Timalsina clarified that he is not a person who believes in any kind of violence. "Instead, I am determined that peace should prevail in the country even when it is a victim of violence," he wrote. Timalsina has accused people around Deuba of misleading him by giving him false information. "Many have lied to you, brother, and they are still lying to you. As long as Sher Bahadur gathered information himself, he was wonderful. Ever since he started relying on information from others, things have gone wrong, brother," he wrote. "The problem is more with your informants than with you, brother." Timalsina claims that Deuba has also accused party president Gagan Thapa based on information from the same 'liars'. Stating that Deuba does not know him, he has urged him to ask the Panchthar Congress about his and his family's contribution to the Congress or to recall the incident in which Deuba himself participated in the 'Policy Hackathon' program that he led at the central office. He has also mentioned that he was the first person to hoist the flag when the party office was set on fire and that he will be proud of it for the rest of his life. Timalsina has also raised serious political and moral questions about Deuba's presidency. He alleges that arbitrary alliances were formed during Deuba's tenure, that the people were left without an opposition, that there was an attempt to establish a narrative that there is no principle in politics, and that there was a tendency to form alliances with anyone for power. "The party has become even weaker with the allegations of financial mismanagement coming every month. All this happened during your tenure," Timalsina wrote. "The Congress has been growing stronger and weaker in power, but it has only become morally weak under your presidency." He mentioned his respect for Deuba and reminded him of BP Koirala's political culture. 'I respect you for many things, but your and my ideal leader BP Koirala himself has taught me not to make baseless accusations when criticizing,' he wrote.

भ्रममा पारिरहेको आरोप लगाएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरैले ढाँटे दाइ, अझै ढाँट्दैछन् । जबसम्म शेरबहादुर आफैँ सूचना जम्मा गर्थे, गजब थिए । जबदेखि अरूको सूचनामा भर पर्न थाले, बिजोग भयो दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘समस्या जति तपाईँमा हो, त्योभन्दा धेरै तपाईँका खबरिलालमा हो दाइ ।’ पार्टी सभापति गगन थापामाथि पनि तिनै ‘ढटुवाहरू’को सूचनाका आधारमा देउवाले आरोप लगाएको तिमल्सिनाको दाबी छ । देउवाले आफूलाई नचिनेको बताउँदै उनले आफ्नो र परिवारको कांग्रेसमा रहेको योगदानबारे पाँचथर कांग्रेसलाई सोध्न वा केन्द्रीय कार्यालयमा आफूले नेतृत्व गरेको ‘पोलिसी ह्याकाथन’ कार्यक्रममा देउवा स्वयं सहभागी भएको घटना स्मरण गर्न आग्रह गरेका छन् । पार्टी कार्यालय जल्दा झन्डा ओढाउन जाने पहिलो व्यक्ति आफू नै रहेको र त्यसमा आजीवन गर्व रहनेसमेत उनले उल्लेख गरेका छन् । तिमल्सिनाले देउवाको सभापतित्व कार्यकालमाथि गम्भीर राजनीतिक तथा नैतिक प्रश्नसमेत उठाएका छन् । देउवाको कार्यकालमा मनपरी गठबन्धन भएको, जनतालाई प्रतिपक्षविहीन हालतमा छोडिएको, राजनीतिमा सिद्धान्त हुँदैन भन्ने भाष्य स्थापित गर्न खोजिएको र सत्ताका लागि जोसँग पनि गठबन्धन गर्न सक्ने प्रवृत्ति हाबी भएको उनको आरोप छ । ‘हरेक महिना आउने आर्थिक अपचलनका आरोपले पार्टी झनै कमजोर बन्यो । यो सबै तपाईँको कार्यकालमा भएको हो,’ तिमल्सिनाले लेखेका छन्, ‘कांग्रेस सत्तामा बलियो–कमजोर भइरह्यो तर नैतिक हिसाबले कमजोर तपाईँको सभापतित्वमा मात्रै भएको हो ।’ उनले देउवाप्रति सम्मान रहेको उल्लेख गर्दै बीपी कोइरालाको राजनीतिक संस्कार स्मरण गराएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरै कुराको लागि इज्जत गर्छु तर आलोचना गर्दा घटिया आरोप लगाउनु हुन्न भन्ने स्वयं तपाईँको र मेरो आदर्श नेता बीपी कोइरालाले सिकाउनु भएको छ दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन् । Kathmandu. Nepali Congress youth leader Sachin Timalsina has strongly refuted the allegations leveled against him by former party president and former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba. He has termed Deuba's statement as 'nonsense' and 'based on false information'. Deuba, while addressing the second Gandaki Province-level convention of the 'Parallel Congress' in Pokhara recently, had accused Gagan Thapa of giving tickets to those who said he should be killed. Without naming Gagan, he had said, 'He gave tickets to those who said Sher Bahadur Deuba's house should be attacked. He also gave tickets to those who said I should be killed at number 4. It has become clear who is trying to set fire to the houses of our Netaji's across the country and kill us.' Timalsina responded on social media, considering Deuba's accusations as targeted at him. He was defeated as the Congress candidate from Kathmandu Constituency No. 4 in the House of Representatives elections held on March 21. Responding to Deuba's statement, Timalsina clarified that he is not a person who believes in any kind of violence. "Instead, I am determined that peace should prevail in the country even when it is a victim of violence," he wrote. Timalsina has accused people around Deuba of misleading him by giving him false information. "Many have lied to you, brother, and they are still lying to you. As long as Sher Bahadur gathered information himself, he was wonderful. Ever since he started relying on information from others, things have gone wrong, brother," he wrote. "The problem is more with your informants than with you, brother." Timalsina claims that Deuba has also accused party president Gagan Thapa based on information from the same 'liars'. Stating that Deuba does not know him, he has urged him to ask the Panchthar Congress about his and his family's contribution to the Congress or to recall the incident in which Deuba himself participated in the 'Policy Hackathon' program that he led at the central office. He has also mentioned that he was the first person to hoist the flag when the party office was set on fire and that he will be proud of it for the rest of his life. Timalsina has also raised serious political and moral questions about Deuba's presidency. He alleges that arbitrary alliances were formed during Deuba's tenure, that the people were left without an opposition, that there was an attempt to establish a narrative that there is no principle in politics, and that there was a tendency to form alliances with anyone for power. "The party has become even weaker with the allegations of financial mismanagement coming every month. All this happened during your tenure," Timalsina wrote. "The Congress has been growing stronger and weaker in power, but it has only become morally weak under your presidency." He mentioned his respect for Deuba and reminded him of BP Koirala's political culture. 'I respect you for many things, but your and my ideal leader BP Koirala himself has taught me not to make baseless accusations when criticizing,' he wrote.

‘हरेक महिना आउने आर्थिक अपचलनका आरोपले पार्टी झनै कमजोर बन्यो । यो सबै तपाईँको कार्यकालमा भएको हो,’ तिमल्सिनाले लेखेका छन्, ‘कांग्रेस सत्तामा बलियो–कमजोर भइरह्यो तर नैतिक हिसाबले कमजोर तपाईँको सभापतित्वमा मात्रै भएको हो ।’

उनले देउवाप्रति सम्मान रहेको उल्लेख गर्दै बीपी कोइरालाको राजनीतिक संस्कार स्मरण गराएका छन् । ‘तपाईँलाई धेरै कुराको लागि इज्जत गर्छु तर आलोचना गर्दा घटिया आरोप लगाउनु हुन्न भन्ने स्वयं तपाईँको र मेरो आदर्श नेता बीपी कोइरालाले सिकाउनु भएको छ दाइ,’ उनले लेखेका छन् ।

Kathmandu. Nepali Congress youth leader Sachin Timalsina has strongly refuted the allegations leveled against him by former party president and former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba. He has termed Deuba's statement as 'nonsense' and 'based on false information'. Deuba, while addressing the second Gandaki Province-level convention of the 'Parallel Congress' in Pokhara recently, had accused Gagan Thapa of giving tickets to those who said he should be killed. Without naming Gagan, he had said, 'He gave tickets to those who said Sher Bahadur Deuba's house should be attacked. He also gave tickets to those who said I should be killed at number 4. It has become clear who is trying to set fire to the houses of our Netaji's across the country and kill us.' Timalsina responded on social media, considering Deuba's accusations as targeted at him. He was defeated as the Congress candidate from Kathmandu Constituency No. 4 in the House of Representatives elections held on March 21. Responding to Deuba's statement, Timalsina clarified that he is not a person who believes in any kind of violence. "Instead, I am determined that peace should prevail in the country even when it is a victim of violence," he wrote. Timalsina has accused people around Deuba of misleading him by giving him false information. "Many have lied to you, brother, and they are still lying to you. As long as Sher Bahadur gathered information himself, he was wonderful. Ever since he started relying on information from others, things have gone wrong, brother," he wrote. "The problem is more with your informants than with you, brother." Timalsina claims that Deuba has also accused party president Gagan Thapa based on information from the same 'liars'. Stating that Deuba does not know him, he has urged him to ask the Panchthar Congress about his and his family's contribution to the Congress or to recall the incident in which Deuba himself participated in the 'Policy Hackathon' program that he led at the central office. He has also mentioned that he was the first person to hoist the flag when the party office was set on fire and that he will be proud of it for the rest of his life. Timalsina has also raised serious political and moral questions about Deuba's presidency. He alleges that arbitrary alliances were formed during Deuba's tenure, that the people were left without an opposition, that there was an attempt to establish a narrative that there is no principle in politics, and that there was a tendency to form alliances with anyone for power. "The party has become even weaker with the allegations of financial mismanagement coming every month. All this happened during your tenure," Timalsina wrote. "The Congress has been growing stronger and weaker in power, but it has only become morally weak under your presidency." He mentioned his respect for Deuba and reminded him of BP Koirala's political culture. 'I respect you for many things, but your and my ideal leader BP Koirala himself has taught me not to make baseless accusations when criticizing,' he wrote.
